title: ContentGraph
description: Content relationship graph rooted at a given content id. Source of truth: multi-provenance composite read. Explicit edges (inferenceSource=explicit) are Category A (DHT-notarized Relationship entries); computed edges (tag, semantic, system) are Category C (derived on read, not independently persisted); path edges are A2 (derived via link). The view itself is a read projection, never persisted.

rootId.description: CID of the root content node from which the graph was resolved.

totalNodes.description: Total number of nodes in the graph, including the root.

related.description: Direct neighbours of the root node, each carrying their own recursive children.

contentId.description: CID of this related content node.

relationshipType.description: Semantic relationship label (e.g. CONTAINS, RELATES_TO, VALIDATES).

confidence.description: Confidence score for this relationship edge [0, 1].

inferenceSource.description: How this edge was derived: explicit = author-declared; path = co-occurrence in a learning path; tag = shared-tag proximity; semantic = embedding-distance; system = system-generated (e.g. prerequisite inference).

depth.description: Graph depth of this node relative to the root (root neighbours = 1).
